name: Gemma 4 31B (instruction-tuned)
purpose: Gemma 4 is a family of open models for text generation, coding, reasoning and multimodal understanding, from high-end phones to laptops and servers; the 31B dense model targets consumer GPUs, workstations and servers.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Gemma 4 repos carry no LICENSE file; the card links ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/gemma_4_license, which redirects to gemma.ai/resources/apache-2/ (Google DeepMind, read through a summarizer 2026-11-19): plain Apache License 2.0 text ('perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, no-charge, royalty-free, irrevocable' grant), no Gemma-specific terms and no prohibited-use policy. The older Gemma Terms of Use (Gemma 1-3, TranslateGemma) are a different, restrictive text.

architecture.kind: dense transformer, hybrid local/global attention, vision encoder
architecture.attention: sliding window 1024 interleaved with global layers (last always global), unified K/V and p-RoPE in global layers
architecture.why_this_design: Card: hybrid attention interleaves local sliding-window with full global attention (final layer always global) to 'deliver the processing speed and low memory footprint of a lightweight model without sacrificing the deep awareness required for complex, long-context tasks'.

engine_support.notes: No Gemma 4 module in Tona (ArchId list: Qwen4Exp, Qwen35Moe, NemotronHMoe).

strengths: Highest vendor MMMLU (88.4) and MRCR long-context (66.4) among the consumer-GPU models in this set
Apache-2.0 and a very large user base
140+ languages in pre-training, 35+ out of the box
weaknesses: Worst AA-Omniscience on the comparison page (-49 against -6 for Qwen3.8-27B): hallucinates more
Local agent use: tool-call template and parser problems reported
soft.behavior: Thinking is switched on by <|think|> at the start of the system prompt; without it an empty thought block is still emitted. Sampling T=1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 64. Earlier thoughts leave the history except in tool-call turns.

user_reports.summary: Under long context plus reasoning the Gemma 4 family malforms tool calls and loops; commenters blame templates, GGUF packaging and parsers more than the weights.

GGUF users (Q4_K_M, Q6, Q8, official QAT) report the model stops reasoning and answers directly at 29-31K tokens of chat depth; the reporter closed the thread without a confirmed cause (template, llama.cpp or model undetermined).

soft.maturity: Google DeepMind: long-running open family, official QAT builds, many community GGUFs; the first GGUFs had template bugs and a redownload was advised (search summary, 2026-07).

tona_fit.reason: Best published German and long-context numbers of the dense models that fit 24 GB (independent MMLU-ProX DE 82.1, GermEval 82.6; PeerBench Elo 1477), Apache-2.0 (text read). Weak spots: independent hallucination score (AA-Omniscience -49) and INCLUDE DE 68.3 (Qwen3.8-27B: 87.9). Missing Tona module is only a blocker.
